title: Re-study firstmate work handling; add pin-consistency check; rebuild pag
summary: Goal: a newcomer reading the explainer page can verify every citation at one pinned firstmate commit. Re-study work handling (including teardown reopening a backlog item, yolo self-merge, places freed only by recorded PR or cleanup), rebuild the page, and add a code check that the mounted source commit, pin.json and every citation label agree, failing early.

defaults_applied.how: cargo test, clippy, fmt must pass.
Every claim cites path and quote at the pinned commit.
Criteria check the citations resolve at the pinned commit and mismatches are rejected.
Add a mechanism check for the mismatch, not just fix labels.
Pin consistency is enforced by test.
Page and changelog written for outside readers.
Verifier runs cargo test and xtask site.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Reading restated for confirmation: re-derive the study from one pinned commit, rebuild the page from it, and make a mismatch between mount, pin.json and citation labels fail early.

The mounted source's commit cannot be read from git metadata (the mount has none), so the check uses a commit marker supplied by the mount or harness; if none exists, the producer must stop and report it, not silently re-cite.
If the mounted commit differs from 6407052f, the study is re-pinned to the mounted commit in pin.json and all labels, and the CHANGELOG says so; no citation is relabelled without that.
Audience is an outside reader who checks quotes at the pinned commit; places-held wording must be accurate for local-only ships and scouts, which keep their place until cleanup.

acceptance_criteria.text: A check in crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs (or its caller) compares the mounted source commit, pin.json sha, and the sha label on every source in claims.json and rationales.json, and fails with a message naming the differing values.
pin.json and every citation label name one identical commit, which is the commit of the mounted source the quotes were read from; CHANGELOG states the pin decision and any re-pin.

claims.json has cited claims (path, quote, line) that teardown can reopen a backlog item instead of closing it and under which condition; that with yolo on firstmate merges green work itself and what happens with yolo off; and that only a recorded PR or cleanup frees a place, with relaunches and secondmates never counted.

model.json, rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json match the claims, reference only existing claim ids, and do not say a recorded PR frees a place for local-only ships or scouts, which hold it until cleanup.
An outside reader opening the rebuilt index.html finds the three corrected behaviors, each citing the pinned commit, and the quoted lines exist at that commit.
Run `cargo test` from the repository root: the study rules tests, including the new pin-consistency test (which also has a case showing a mismatched label is rejected), and the xtask site tests pass.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`: it succeeds with no unknown claim id error and renders index.html. `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.
No secrets or personal data are written; the study is re-derived from the source, not patched with only the three reviewer points.

out_of_scope: Studying anything in firstmate beyond work handling
Changing the job pipeline outside the study rules check
departures: Higher cost and lower pass odds than reference: the previous attempt failed on a pin mismatch, and this one adds a new code check plus a full re-study.
